_comment: Test-only unpacked extension fixtures, materialized into temporary directories by test/extension-policy.test.js and test/extensions-browser.test.js. Stored as JSON so the Node test runner never executes their scripts.

all-urls.content.js:
// Hostile test fixture: would read every page. Refused unless <all_urls> is granted explicitly.
document.documentElement.dataset.allUrls = 'injected';

mv2.background.js:
// Legacy test fixture: Manifest V2 background pages are unsupported.
chrome.storage.local.set({ legacy: true });

native-messaging.worker.js:
// Hostile test fixture: would bridge pages to a native host. Must be refused before loading.
chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener(message => { chrome.runtime.connectNative('com.example.native').postMessage(message); });

overprivileged.worker.js:
// Hostile test fixture: requests interception, debugging and credential APIs. Must be refused before loading.
chrome.debugger?.attach({ tabId: 1 }, '1.3');

probe.manifest.json:
{
  "manifest_version": 3,
  "name": "Weft compatibility probe",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Test fixture: reports which extension APIs work inside a Weft workspace session.",
  "permissions": ["storage", "scripting", "tabs"],
  "host_permissions": ["http://127.0.0.1/*"],
  "background": { "service_worker": "service-worker.js" },
  "content_scripts": [{ "matches": ["http://127.0.0.1/*"], "js": ["content.js"], "run_at": "document_idle" }],
  "action": { "default_title": "Probe" }
}

toolbar.popup.js:
// Test fixture popup: reports which APIs it has, then tries to leave the extension (which Weft refuses).
chrome.storage.local.set({ opened: true }).then(() => { document.title = 'popup:' + typeof chrome.storage + ':' + typeof chrome.cookies + ':' + typeof chrome.debugger; setTimeout(() => { location.href = 'https://example.invalid/'; }, 50); });
toolbar.options.js:
// Test fixture options page.
chrome.storage.local.get('opened').then(value => { document.title = 'options:' + Boolean(value.opened); });
